plays.jsonl.what: 40 Shakespeare plays: plot/synopsis section (fetch_corpus.py rule), sentences, principal names (raw text, not analysed)

category_members.json.what: Shakespeare film/TV category tree crawl (46 categories)

films_all.jsonl.what: every article in the Shakespeare category tree, named extras and Wikidata P144/P941 derivatives, with plot text and attribution metadata

shakespeare_wikidata.json.what: Wikidata P144 based-on / P941 inspired-by links to each play

shakespeare_adaptations.jsonl.what: per-article selection metadata: documented sources and evidence type, is_film, names kept, source mentions, DEV overlap, eligible/primary flags (no text)

lang_check_qwen3-8b.json.what: made-up sentences: token cost, spans, back-translation, continuation (zh, ja, ru, hi)

lang_check2_qwen3-8b.json.what: made-up passage: translation and 3-question QA (zh, ja, ru, hi)

lang_check3_qwen3-8b.json.what: made-up text: es/de/fr/th token cost and spans; 24-sentence story QA in en/zh/es

t3/category_members.json.what: T3 category crawl: 21 roots, buckets and category paths per article

t3/candidates.jsonl.what: every T3 candidate article: metadata plus raw plot section and sentences (not analysed)

t3/random_population.json.what: random-film population: direct members of Category:YYYY films 1915-2024 with year

t3/random_films.jsonl.what: hash-ordered walk of the population; accepted films carry raw plot text

t3/pool_summary.json.what: T3 counts by bucket, kind, decade; random-sample counts

relatives/wikidata.json.what: Wikidata P941/P144/P4969 links into and out of Batman

relatives/wikipedia_evidence.json.what: influence sentences from Batman-related articles; full-text search hits for derivative phrases

relatives/documented_relatives.json.what: curated ground truth: relation, strength, evidence sentences, candidate works with plot sizes

relatives/works.jsonl.what: fetched works of documented relatives with raw plot text

tools/meta.json.what: HF model metadata (sha, licence, weight size) and PyPI metadata for packages not installed

tools/timing.json.what: dummy-input timings: TF-IDF, presence, LSA, LDA, PCA+HDBSCAN, k-means, c-TF-IDF, 8 encoders (random init)

tools/llm_timing_qwen3-8b.json.what: made-up story: judge per meme (no cache, cached prefix), multi-meme call, flat and recursive summaries

tools/neuron_timing_qwen3-8b.json.what: made-up story: forward + per-work top-3 aggregate on GPU vs full copy

raw/pages/.what: cached Wikipedia API responses (extract, categories, pageprops)
